title: A Feather page (feather.page/1)
description: A website as data: one document renders a complete, themeable site; changing brand restyles all of it. Generated from packages/page/src/core/spec.ts by scripts/generate.ts; validatePage is the authority.

nav.description: The overlay menu: a minimal bar whose Menu opens a full-screen list of large links.

footer.description: The last scene. plain: links and a note. wordmark: the name set as large as the width allows. reveal: the footer waits behind the page and is uncovered as it ends.

notFound.description: The 404, as a small scene with a clear way home. type: the number as display type. minimal: the words alone.

loader.description: Arrival. counter: an honest percentage that lifts off. dock: a bar that fills and becomes the header. Never shown without script or under reduced motion.

sound.description: One ambient bed, off until the person turns it on; the toggle sits in the nav.

srcset.description: The image's widths: a list of { src, w } (w in px), or a srcset string of w descriptors ("a-800.jpg 800w, a-1600.jpg 1600w"). Feather derives the sizes from where the image sits.
The image's widths: a list of { src, w } (w in px), or a srcset string of w descriptors ("a-800.jpg 800w, a-1600.jpg 1600w"). Feather derives the sizes from where the image sits.

oneOf.description: The first view: the display title, a short lede, the brand's medium and the starters. Variants: stacked, giant-type, split, film, product, index, interactive (default stacked). Align: start, center, offset. Scroll: reveal, parallax, scale.
One idea in display type, with an optional line of body. Variants: plain, centred, offset, marquee, fill, swap (default plain). Align: start. Scroll: reveal.
Selected work, from the library or inline. Variants: grid, hover-list, stack, rail, fullscreen-cases, bento (default grid). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal, stack, horizontal.
One piece of work told: a title, the medium, the facts. Variants: editorial, scale (default editorial). Align: start, center. Scroll: reveal, parallax, scale.
Up to four numbers that prove something, counted in. Variants: counter, plain, lead (default counter). Align: start, center, split. Scroll: reveal.
Moments in order. Variants: list, horizontal (default list). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal.
How the work is done, in two to six steps. Variants: list, pinned, rows (default list). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal, pin.
Who it was for. Names are always text; a mark is optional. Variants: grid, marquee (default grid). Align: start, center. Scroll: reveal.
Someone else's words, attributed. Variants: large, rail, pull (default large). Align: start, center, offset. Scroll: reveal.
What can be bought or booked, and for how much. Variants: cards, table, toggle (default cards). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal.
Questions people actually ask. Variants: list (default list). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal.
The one next act: how to reach the real person. Variants: plain (default plain). Align: start, center, offset. Scroll: reveal.
The one block only this brand has. Its renderer is the brand's; without one it shows as a statement. Variants: the brand's own (free text). Align: start, center. Scroll: reveal, parallax.

Images to look through, each opening large in the lightbox. Every image is content: it needs alt text. Variants: rail, masonry, grid, hover-list, wheel (default rail). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal.
Before and after, compared with a slider (a native range); side by side without script. Variants: slider (default slider). Align: start, center. Scroll: reveal.
A story told in two to six steps, each with its picture, which stays pinned and changes as the steps pass. Variants: pinned, stacked (default pinned). Align: start. Scroll: reveal, pin.
Several people's words, attributed: a grid, or a rail. Variants: grid, rail (default grid). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal.
Writing, as an editorial list: date, title, excerpt and the link to read it. Variants: list, featured (default list). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal.
A short form that posts to the page's own endpoint (or opens an email), and works with no script. Variants: underline, conversational (default underline). Align: start, center, split. Scroll: reveal.
A film with its controls and captions: play and pause, mute, and a captions track when anyone speaks. Variants: player (default player). Align: start, center. Scroll: reveal.

Questions with real radio options, one per step, and a result keyed by the answers. With no script, every question shows, and how the result is decided. Variants: steps (default steps). Align: start, center, split. Scroll: reveal.

A booking flow: service, then date and time, then details, then a review before anything is sent. Slots come from the page; it sends to an action URL, a mailto, or hands over to a booking link. Variants: steps (default steps). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal.

A pricing calculator: inputs (range, number, radio, toggle) and a price formula in a small safe language (+ - * /, min, max, round). The total and its breakdown are announced as they change; with no script, the starting prices show. Variants: split, stacked (default split). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal.

Data as a bar, line or area chart, drawn in SVG in the theme's inks, with its summary sentence and the data as a table behind a disclosure. The end state draws in on reveal; under reduced motion it is simply there. Variants: bar, line, area (default bar). Align: start, center, split. Scroll: reveal.

Places to find: always a list of names, addresses and links (directions, the place's own site, a phone number), with an optional still map. No map SDK and no tiles. Variants: list, map (default list). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal.

Episodes on native audio with real-button controls (play, ±15 s, speed, a scrub slider), chapters that seek, and a transcript (required) that can follow playback. Never autoplays; with no script, the browser's own controls. Variants: list (default list). Align: start, split. Scroll: reveal.
